memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate, and one pair of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate, and also seven pairs of every kind of bird, male and female, to keep their various kinds alive throughout the earth." - Gen 7:2-3 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
In the middle of a story about judgement, God pauses to give careful instructions about the animals. He wants them preserved - "to keep their various kinds alive throughout the earth." Even as the world is about to be swept clean of its corruption, God is making provision for life to continue. His plan is not only to judge, but to preserve and renew.

This reveals something beautiful about our God. He is the Creator who cares for all that He has made, down to the birds and beasts. Nothing He created is beneath His notice or concern. The same God who counts the stars also numbers the creatures and provides for their future.

Jesus pointed to this same tender care: "Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground outside your Father's care" (Matt 10:29). If God so carefully preserves the animals through the flood, how much more does He care for you, made in His very image?

There is deep comfort here. We serve a God of detail and provision, who thinks ahead, who preserves life, who plans for renewal even in the midst of judgement. If He so faithfully cares for the sparrows and the beasts, you can trust Him with the details of your own life. You are worth more than many sparrows.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you trust God with the small details of your life?
- How does God's care for creation reassure you of His care for you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Creator God, thank You that You care for everything You have made, down to the smallest creature. Help me trust that if You provide for the sparrows, You will surely provide for me.
